title: Add Algeria.xlsx for the state management tutorial
description:
## Why

The **state management** tutorial (`07-functions-state_management-quarto`) has learners run this in their IDE:

```r
read_data_url <- function(url) {
  temp <- fs::file_temp()
  download.file(url, destfile = temp)
  read_data(temp)
}

read_data_url(url = url_algeria)
```

`url_algeria` currently points at `rsacdn.link`, the legacy Academy CDN backed by the private `rstudio/teachthis` repo (last pushed January 2023). I'm removing the CDN dependency from `rstudio/academyTutorials`, and this is the one file that can't become a bundled Quarto Live resource — the whole point of the exercise is downloading from a URL, and the download runs in the learner's own Workbench session.

This repo is the natural public home: learners already clone it for this course, and the file sits with the tutorial that uses it.

## The file

Copied byte-for-byte from the CDN (9,383 bytes). Verified it parses exactly as the tutorial's `read_data()` expects:

```
sheets: Summary, Data
readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = 2, col_names = c("country","continent","year","lifeExp","pop","gdpPercap"), skip = 5)
#> 11 x 6, first row: Algeria / Africa / 1957 / 45.685 / 10270856 / 3013.976
```

Same structure as the sibling `.xlsx` files in the purrr-map tutorial, so nothing about the exercise changes.

## Note on sequencing

Nothing in this repo reads this file, so this is additive and safe to merge on its own. The follow-up PR in `academyTutorials` repoints `url_algeria` at:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rstudio/academy-pinr-ide-tutorials/main/07-functions-state_management-quarto/data/Algeria.xlsx
```

That URL 404s until this merges, so **this PR should merge first**.
